scope: Production HEX20 global assembly/Newton and independent surface/volume integration for an exactly representable synthetic LQ solution; separate local NT material checks

analytic_definition.eta_n_and_eta_p: s*x/L; linear relative concentration variables, not logarithms

matrix.initial_state: Zero free fields with endpoint Dirichlet values projected by production solver

gates.temperature_normalization: Actual analytic peak, no 1 K floor

independence.analytic_current_and_heat: Direct closed scalar formulas, not generated by the production response
independence.power: Physical exterior -phi*J.n and independent 4/5-order volume integration
independence.diffusion_work: JE integral minus separately integrated q*N*(mu_n+mu_p)*|E|^2
independence.excluded_auxiliary_field: independent_flux_audit diffusion_work uses actual densities and is not a valid LQ reference-density decomposition
independence.negative_controls: Original drift source evaluated on accepted gradient state; temperature multiplied by 1.1 without re-solving

legacy_A1J: Optional current_work defaults to false; same legacy output and arithmetic sequence when absent. A1JJE enables material branch and changes only its identification preamble.
